import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

# Fetch the Wikipedia page for the list of countries by GDP (nominal)
url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_by_GDP_(nominal)'
response = requests.get(url)

# Parse the HTML content if the request is successful
if response.status_code == 200:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')
    table = soup.find('table', {'class': 'wikitable'})
    
    max_gdp_country = ''
    max_gdp_value = 0
    
    for row in table.find_all('tr')[1:]:  # Skip header row
        cells = row.find_all('td')
        if len(cells) > 2:
            country_name = cells[1].text.strip()
            gdp_value = cells[2].text.strip().replace(',', '').replace('$', '')
            try:
                gdp_value = float(gdp_value)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            
            if gdp_value > max_gdp_value:
                max_gdp_value = gdp_value
                max_gdp_country = country_name
    max_gdp_country
else:
    None
